summary: The result reporting for job 61409171 passes. Each claim in RESULTS-61409171.md that I checked matches evidence/job61409171-results.json, the sacct file and the case ordering in plan.py. The sacct record shows COMPLETED, exit 0:0, 01:28:51 on nid001020. There are 35 records (2 acceptance, 3 bridge, 24 comparison, 6 anchors) in exactly plan.cases() order. I recomputed every median, range, paired ECC/S ratio and difference, the staging drift, the bridge median, the cube-bank totals, the cache-attempt histogram and the minimum free memory, and all match. The report keeps the needed caveats: E vs S differences are comparable to drift, timings are whole-pipeline rather than kernel-only, there is no GPU-only scaling claim, cube checks are basic content checks, cache evidence covers the host page cache only, and the cause of the retries is unknown. One low, non-blocking finding: a stale line in status.json (C2R-R1-01). Nothing blocks reporting.

Cube semantics: cube_check.py:51-58 bins by ordinal % 99, so bin 99 is always empty and populated_bins=99 is expected. cube_check.py:28-31 requires finite values and nonzero bins exactly where count>0. Host payload bytes are 0, nothing is exported and no reference check is made, as RESULTS states.
Memory: the minimum min_sampled_free_gib is 12.808837890625, in full-r1-bd4-ECC and full-r2-bd4-ECC, matching the reported 12.809 GiB.

Cache: 32 cases took one attempt and 3 took two. full-r2-bd4-E, bridge-r3 and anchor-r3-bd1-S had 1/1, 8/8 and 5/5 resident pages in the first evict/verify scans, all in s005, and 0/0 in the second pair. Conditioning took 44.540, 47.249 and 46.031 s, matching RESULTS lines 27-29.
Paired ratios come from matched same-repeat S runs. The report uses the median paired ratio rather than the ratio of medians.
status.json phase is comparison02_completed_result_review_pending, with pending listing Independent result review. completed_cases is 35.
limitations: I ran no commands. I did not recompute hashes, bundle or pin integrity, affinity, the GPU UUID/PCI mapping, the summary_sha256 match, or the sidecar-versus-history comparison. These rest on the coordinator's re-audit.
The compact evidence has no raw 100k stamps, per-bin count vectors or per-case audit receipts. Exact per-bin counts are inferred from status=pass under cube_check.py logic.
I did not inspect the immutable attempt directory on scratch, audit.py, storage.py or runner.py in detail. No claim needed them beyond what the earlier review established.
The per-device results of 31 tests, 93 phase reports and 10 guards are coordinator summaries. The raw device reports were not in scope.
